record.original_title: Documento CONPES 4144 de 2025: Política Nacional de Inteligencia Artificial
record.summary: Colombia's national AI policy, approved by CONPES and prepared by the National Planning Department with six ministries and the Presidency, sets more than 100 actions to 2030 under six axes. Four are enabling conditions: governance and ethical principles for responsible AI, infrastructure and data, research and innovation, and skills and talent. A cross-cutting axis on preventing and mitigating AI risks covers environmental impact, labour protection, mental-health effects and tools against deepfakes, false news and identity impersonation; the sixth promotes ethical adoption of AI in public bodies, businesses and the regions.
record.notes: Approved on 14 Feb 2025, with an indicative investment of COP 479,000 million. The Ministry of ICT, the Administrative Department of the Presidency, the Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation and the National Planning Department lead its implementation, with the Planning Department coordinating. The governance axis provides for stakeholder participation in evaluating the policy, an expert advisory council and normative instruments to verify compliance with ethical principles for AI.
record.scope_note: Mainly a policy for AI infrastructure, data, research, skills and adoption; included as Colombia's national AI policy, two of whose six axes cover AI governance and ethics and the prevention and mitigation of AI risks.

verification.note: Recheck of 18 Oct 2026: re-read the government normative compilation on normativa.colpensiones.gov.co (stored 11 Oct 2026), which gives the document's cover: 'Documento CONPES 4144 DNP de 2025 (febrero 14)', the issuing council, the participating ministries, 'Versión aprobada' and 'Bogotá, D.C., 14 de febrero de 2025'; it links the full PDF only on normograma.com. Also re-read the DNP article on CONPES 4144 in its journal Planeación y Desarrollo (No. 21, stored 11 Oct 2026 from dnp.gov.co), written by staff of DNP's Digital Development Directorate, which describes the six axes, the risk-mitigation measures, the more than 100 actions to 2030, the COP 479,000 million and the lead entities; the summary rests on that article. Both files were found unchanged on 17 Oct 2026. The policy document itself is not stored: its PDF on colaboracion.dnp.gov.co was requested in this run, but the copy stored on 17 Oct 2026 has no readable text (24 characters) and the browser retry failed on a certificate error. No English version was found.

judgment.status_reasoning: The normative compilation marks the document 'Versión aprobada' and dated 14 Feb 2025; the DNP article (May 2025) describes its implementation under way, with actions running to 2030. Nothing in the stored files shows it replaced or withdrawn, so it stays 'Published (non-binding, current)'.
judgment.scope_reasoning: A national AI policy whose main content is development and adoption, with axes on governance and ethics and on preventing AI risks: in scope, with a scope_note as a strategy whose main focus is not safety.
judgment.date_reasoning: date_published is the approval date on the cover, 14 Feb 2025 ('Bogotá, D.C., 14 de febrero de 2025'; '(febrero 14)'), which the DNP article confirms.

extra_urls.reason: The CONPES 4144 policy document itself, as the DNP's SisCONPES link in the stored DNP article points to it; needed to check the summary, the axes and the action plan against the policy text rather than the DNP article. If its host refuses the archiver, the record keeps resting on the compilation and the article.

open_questions: The CONPES 4144 document itself is not stored (the colaboracion.dnp.gov.co PDF came back without readable text), so the summary and safety topics rest on the DNP's own article about the policy rather than on the policy text; a person could provide the PDF (Provide a document).
